Attach a mini-motorized drill bit to its tip (yes, you read that right!) and voilà – instant kinetic art piece meets stationery hack. Watch pencils spin wildly like dervishes amidst swirling shavings. 

5. **Micro-Sculpture Forge**: Turn any rusty, abandoned screwdriver into an avant-garde sculpture forge. Wrap a glowing LED strip around the handle, melt molten wax over a candle flame, then shape it into fantastical forms atop the screwdriver's twisted body. Your guests will gasp in awe when they behold this incandescent marvel, reminiscent of Hieronymous Bosch-esque dreamscape visions.
